methodologyNotes: Published self-serve USD pricing was collected directly from each vendor's official pricing page where accessible, or from a clearly-cited reputable comparison source where the vendor page returned a non-200 status or disclosed no prices. Background check vendors in this sector predominantly use a per-report (pay-as-you-go) billing model rather than flat monthly subscriptions; monthlyUsd records the per-check price for the smallest billable unit (one report). annualDiscountPct is null for all vendors because no annual subscription discounts apply in a per-check model. Quote-only / contact-sales tiers carry null monthlyUsd. Telephony fields (minutesIncluded, callsIncluded, overagePerMin, overagePerCall) are null on every plan because this is a non-telephony vertical. accessedAt is 2026-06-14 on every source. Certn CAD pricing was disregarded; USD pricing was sourced from certn.co/us/pricing/. Sterling Check (now First Advantage), HireRight, and Accurate Background publish no self-serve USD pricing and are recorded as quote-only.
